pages.title: Grinding
pages.text: $(thing)Sneak$() and right click a $(item)Grindstone$(). Your main hand can be $(thing)empty$(), or holding the material.$(br2)A plain right click still opens Repair and Disenchant, so the grindstone keeps its usual job. Drop the material in, take the dust out.

pages.title: Yield
pages.text: Cheap ore grinds well, precious ore does not. The yield is the whole cost.$(li)Coal, Copper, Zinc: 4 dust.$(li)Lapis: 3 dust.$(li)Iron, Gold, Quartz, Amethyst: 2 dust.$(li)Diamond, Emerald: 1 dust.$(li)Netherite: 1 dust.

pages.title: Two exceptions
pages.text: $(thing)Redstone$() has no dust of ours, because the ore already drops one. Feed vanilla Redstone Dust to the chamber directly.$(br2)$(thing)Netherite$() takes the ingot, not scrap. That is four scrap and four gold for a single dust, and it is meant to be the most expensive thing you can attune to.
